title: console: the public form thank-you panel fills its record field tokens from the submit answer (#28005 ui half)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled split. #28005 was ruled B by the maintainer at 2026-10-31 15:10Z (ruling record 6545210989): spec first, then server, then ui. This is the ui step.
Reach: the web-to-case visitor, who sees their case number on the thank-you panel instead of the literal token text.
Blocked-by: #28440 (spec half) and #28443 (server half) (the submit answer carries `fields`).

## Wanted

- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`: the `thank-you` panel's `title` / `message` replace each `{{record.field_name}}` token with `fields[field_name]` from the submit answer, read through the spec's `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema`.
- A token with no value in the answer renders as empty, never as the literal token text.
- Values are inserted as text and never as HTML.
- Use the same token reading as the spec. `thankYouRecordFieldNames` and the spec's token regex are the one grammar, so do not write a second regex.

## Riders

- **Skills-docs follow-up** (from #28440's `Skills-docs:` line): once this lands, teach the slot in `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`. Write it as one sentence plus an example, and say that only engine-generated fields (autonumber) may be named.
- **Translated panel text:** a translation may name a field the base text does not. The server fills only the base text's names, so such a token renders empty. Whether to judge translated text is this card's question. Report what you measure; do not widen.

## Tests

- A message with `{{record.case_number}}` shows the answer's value.
- A missing value renders empty.
- HTML in a value is shown as text.
- Ablation: dropping the fill reds the test.
